# UNSHADED

> UNSHADED is a story-driven mystery game by solo developer Solo Prodigy Dev, set in the Kingdom of Seren. The player investigates a kingdom split by war using Echoes of the Iris, memories that show fragments of the past but never answers. The people of Seren remember what the player says and does.

## Game
- [UNSHADED game page](https://soloprodigydev.github.io/unshaded/): premise, features and interactive demos
- [Solo Prodigy Dev home](https://soloprodigydev.github.io/): studio page and game wheel
